difficulty_rationale.prospective_basis: Across the independently frozen v14-v16 topology replications, flat was the weakest topology at 4/6 while direct and hierarchical were each 6/6.
difficulty_rationale.natural_d2_ambiguity: Both flat and hierarchical decompositions are legal at D2. Flat is the required utility choice because it uses three total admissions rather than a manager plus three leaves.

enabled: typed topology decision and selected-action normalization
root flat passive fan-in and strict finalization

p_plus.selector: Choose the first attempt satisfying the answer-free structural eligibility rule; if none is eligible, choose the first attempt.

minimum_useful_signal.condition: P hard-fails and P+ answer-free-selected attempt hard-succeeds

post_gap_attribution.compression_eligibility: Only winning behavior representable inside the ordinary D2 P envelope is eligible.

interpretation_boundary: A pass establishes that bounded extra inference search finds better trajectories within the same D2 reachable graph. It does not establish compute-to-weights compression, which requires a later causal role-local update and ordinary-compute P-prime evaluation.
